en: [[Its location]] in the North Atlantic Ocean [[covers]] [[a large area]] between Florida, Puerto Rico, and Bermuda Island.
me: between Florida, Puerto Rico, and Bermuda Island.
easy: Its location covers a large area
그곳의 위치는 넓은 지역을 차지한다(cover 덮다→차지하다).
between Florida, Puerto Rico, and Bermuda Island
요약: 북대서양의 이곳은 세 곳 사이의 넓은 바다를 차지한다.
notes: 주어와 동사 사이의 꾸미는 말은 건너뛰고 진짜 주어를 찾는다: location(단수) → cover(X) covers
in the North Atlantic Ocean 같은 전치사구는 주어를 꾸미는 말일 뿐, 수 일치와 관계없다

easy: Many ships and planes have gotten lost
많은 배와 비행기가 실종되었다(get lost 길을 잃다).
요약: 많은 배와 비행기가 그곳에서 길을 잃고 사라졌다.
notes: A and B가 주어면 복수 → has(X) have gotten. 예: Tom and Jane are friends.
get + 형용사 = ~한 상태가 되다. get lost = 길을 잃다

en: [[Their pilots]] [[had reported]] [[problems]] shortly before they were lost, a fact that has shocked investigators for decades.
me: a fact that has shocked investigators for decades.
easy: a fact that has shocked investigators
수사관들에게 충격을 준 사실(shock 충격을 주다).
요약: 사라지기 직전 문제를 알렸다는 사실이 수십 년째 수사관을 놀라게 한다.
notes: that 뒤에는 진짜 동사가 필요하다: shocking(X) → has shocked
for + 기간(수십 년 동안)이 지금까지 이어질 땐 현재완료 has p.p.

en: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, [[another plane]] carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby, also [[disappeared]] in the same location, and experts are still trying to explain why.
me: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes,
another plane carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby,
and experts are still trying to explain why.
easy: As the Coast Guard was searching
요약: 수색 중에 근처를 날던 비행기도 같은 곳에서 사라졌다.
notes: which 절에는 진짜 동사가 필요하다: flying(X) → was flying (be + -ing: ~하고 있던 중)
carrying 13 passengers는 plane을 뒤에서 꾸미는 -ing (13명을 태운)

en: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, [[another plane]] carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby, also [[disappeared]] in the same location, and experts are still trying to explain why.
me: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes,
another plane carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby,
and experts are still trying to explain why.
easy: 그리고 전문가들은 여전히 애쓰고 있다(try 애쓰다).
요약: 비행기가 또 사라졌고, 전문가들은 아직도 이유를 찾고 있다.
notes: and 뒤에 새 주어(experts)가 오면 그 주어의 동사가 꼭 필요하다: still trying(X) → are still trying
are + -ing = 지금 ~하고 있다 (현재진행). 아직도 계속되는 일에 쓴다

en: [[What we are mainly responsible for at times like these]] [[is]] [[collecting donations]].
key: 우리가 주로 맡은 일은 기부금을 모으는 것이다.
me: What we are mainly responsible for at times like these
easy: What we are mainly responsible for
우리가 주로 책임지는 일(be responsible for ~을 책임지다).
요약: 이럴 때 우리의 주된 일은 기부금을 모으는 것이다.
notes: What이 이끄는 긴 덩어리(명사절)가 주어면 단수 취급: are(X) → is
주어 = 보어(What절 = collecting donations)라서 be동사로 이어 준다

en: [[Most of the donations we receive]] [[come]] in the form of food, clothing, and blankets.
me: Most of the donations we receive
in the form of food, clothing, and blankets.
easy: in the form of food, clothing, and blankets
요약: 받는 기부는 대부분 음식, 옷, 담요다.
notes: most / some / few + of + 명사가 주어면 of 뒤 명사에 맞춘다: donations(복수) → comes(X) come
we receive는 donations를 꾸미는 말. 동사 come의 주어는 Most of the donations

en: However, [[other ways to help the group]] [[include]] [[giving cash and volunteering]], opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
me: other ways to help the group
opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
easy: Other ways include giving and volunteering
다른 방법으로는 기부와 자원봉사가 있다(include 포함하다).
other ways to help the group
요약: 현금 기부와 자원봉사로도 이 단체를 도울 수 있다.
notes: and 앞뒤는 같은 모양: giving(-ing) and volunteering(-ing). volunteer(X)
include의 목적어가 동명사 두 개 → giving cash, volunteering

en: However, [[other ways to help the group]] [[include]] [[giving cash and volunteering]], opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
me: other ways to help the group
opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
easy: Other ways include giving and volunteering
요약: 사람들이 아는 것보다 더 값진 방법들이다.
notes: than 뒤에 주어(people)가 있으면 진짜 동사도 있어야 한다: realizing(X) → realize
than people often realize = 사람들이 흔히 알아차리는 것보다. 주어 people(복수) → realize

en: [[We]] [[will send]] [[you]] [[details]] on how to help if you contact us online, and every volunteer is truly appreciated.
key: 우리는 당신에게 세부 사항을 보낼 것이다.
me: on how to help if you contact us online,
and every volunteer is truly appreciated.
easy: 저희가 당신에게 세부 사항을 보낼 것입니다(send 보내다).
and every volunteer is truly appreciated
그리고 모든 자원봉사자는 진심으로 감사받는다(appreciate 감사하다).
요약: 연락 주시면 방법을 알려 드립니다. 자원봉사자는 모두 소중합니다.
notes: every + 단수명사는 단수 취급: are(X) → is appreciated. 예: Every student is here.
is appreciated = 감사를 받는다 (be p.p. 수동)
